newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev falls to 515-530 per dollar at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev falls to 515-530 per dollar at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 515-530 per dollar, down from 500-520 in the morning, as foreign currency demand topped supply in light interbank volume and the central bank was not seen supporting the lev, dealers said.

"Large final clients again bid for dollars amid excessively low supply, and the lev lost some 50-60 (levs) from Friday," a commercial bank dealer said. The lev closed around 469-473 per dollar on Friday.
The central bank was not seen supporting the lev through dollar sales on the market, dealers said.
"Anticipation of an unrestrained lev fall made banks very cautious, and dollars were offered at increasingly high exchange rates," another dealer said.
High foreign currency demand from large fuel and energy importers has persisted amid shrinking supply for a week now, strongly pressuring the lev. The lev traded at 362-364 per dollar a week ago.
